name: Anthropic Claude Code CLI

versions_seen.where: https://api.github.com/repos/anthropics/claude-code/releases (latest, published 2026-10-23); hooks reference https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks read 2026-10-24, not installed or probed

cocheck_relevance: Observable today through user-level settings hooks (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, UserPromptSubmit, Stop, SubagentStop). Narration comes from the transcript JSONL named in transcript_path; per-call reason from tool_input.description.

install.claim: Native install puts launcher ~/.local/bin/claude as a symlink into ~/.local/share/claude/versions/<ver>.
Native install is the recommended path; Homebrew casks (claude-code stable, claude-code@latest), WinGet, apt/dnf/apk and npm also exist.

processes_and_paths.claim: User state lives in ~/.claude (settings.json, projects/, plugins/, hooks/, skills/, agents/, sessions/, history.jsonl); ~/.claude.json holds more state.
CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR relocates the home directory files.
A ClaudeCode.app bundle sits in ~/.local/share/claude/ (desktop surface).

auth.claim: Needs Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise or Console account, or a cloud provider; login via browser. Credentials not read.

available.claim: Hooks are a first-class feature; events run commands (also http, mcp_tool, prompt, agent handlers) with JSON on stdin.

config.claim: User hooks in ~/.claude/settings.json; project in .claude/settings.json; local in .claude/settings.local.json; plugin hooks/hooks.json; skill and subagent frontmatter. Entries merge across levels; identical handlers run once.

Managed policy settings apply above all: macOS /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json (+ managed-settings.d/), Linux /etc/claude-code/, MDM domain com.anthropic.claudecode, or server-managed.
Precedence: managed, command line (--settings), project local, shared project, user.
Real settings.json on this Mac has hook keys for UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, Stop, SubagentStop (key names only read).
config.note: CoCheck entries were uninstalled 2026-10-15 per backup file names; remaining hooks are the user's own. Values not read; whose entries these are is not established.

config.claim: Matcher entry shape is {matcher, hooks:[{type:'command',command}]}; a matcher of "*", "" or none matches all. CoCheck writes matcher '*' for the three tool events and none for the others.
config.note: Shape from the hooks page; CoCheck's writer is src/hosts/claude.ts.

config.claim: Handler fields: common `type`, `if`, `timeout`, `statusMessage`, `once` (skill frontmatter only); command-only `command`, `args` (exec form), `async`, `asyncRewake`, `shell` (bash or powershell), `onFailure`; http-only `url`, `headers`, `allowedEnvVars`, `onFailure`. `onFailure: continue|block` arrived in 2.1.295 (2026-10-08).

Universal output fields: `continue`, `stopReason`, `suppressOutput` (accepted, no effect), `systemMessage`, `terminalSequence`; output strings are capped at 10,000 characters; Stop is capped at 8 consecutive continuations.

Changelog 2.1.299 to 2.1.310 hook changes: 2.1.299 UserPromptSubmit runs before skill/slash-command expansion and actions a plugin hook can block are refused; 2.1.300 updatedInput from PreToolUse and PermissionRequest is validated, plugin WorktreeCreate/Remove run with --worktree, SessionEnd hooks no longer skipped when exiting during a background command; 2.1.302 at most 12 prompt or agent hooks of one event run at a time; 2.1.304 a PreToolUse deny reason is no longer replaced by a timeout error and skills may register at most 1,024 hooks; 2.1.309 PowerShell hooks block on exit 2; 2.1.310 Windows PreToolUse and PermissionRequest hooks no longer let a call through when Git Bash is missing.
config.note: Release dates come from the GitHub releases API, not from CHANGELOG.md. Windows items do not apply to this Mac.

trust_or_approval.claim: disableAllHooks cannot disable managed hooks; allowManagedHooksOnly blocks user/project/local/plugin hooks; project-skill/subagent hooks follow workspace trust.
--bare skips hooks; --setting-sources '' with --settings isolates config (used by the probe).

Policy flags: `allowedHttpHookUrls` (when set at any level, http hooks run only for allowlisted URLs) and `httpHookAllowedEnvVars` (limits env interpolation into http hook headers); `/hooks` is a read-only menu of configured hooks and their sources; an identical handler defined in several settings files runs once, plugin and skill copies stay separate.

missing_events.claim: No per-token or per-assistant-message hook except MessageDisplay; no hook carries the model's text before a tool call (Pre has no narration field). Narration must come from the transcript.

config_paths.claim: Plugin scope: <plugin>/hooks/hooks.json, or an inline `hooks` key in the plugin manifest; registered at plugin load.
Skill scope: `hooks:` frontmatter in SKILL.md registers when the skill is invoked and lasts the session.
Agent scope: subagent frontmatter hooks, removed when the subagent ends (Stop becomes SubagentStop); plugin agents ignore `hooks` frontmatter.

surfaces.claim: The Desktop app Code tab runs hooks and shares settings with the CLI.

Cloud (web) sessions run hooks, but do not read ~/.claude/settings.json and do not load local or repo-enabled plugins (only org-managed ones); they do read the repo's .claude/settings.json. SessionStart hooks have time limits there. CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE=true is set.
surfaces.note: A cloud hook runs on Anthropic's machine, not the Mac, so it cannot write ~/CoCheckData.

surfaces.claim: In self-hosted environments only operator-seeded or managed hooks run.

Agent SDK: callback hooks (options.hooks) and, when settingSources is enabled (default for query()), shell hooks from settings files. The Python SDK lacks SessionStart, SessionEnd and PostToolBatch callbacks; TypeScript has all 33. Hooks may not fire when max_turns is hit.
Not covered by hooks: a user interrupt skips Stop; a call rejected before it runs skips PostToolUseFailure.

skill_and_plugin_paths.claim: Skills: ~/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md (personal), <repo>/.claude/skills/ (project), nested <subdir>/.claude/skills, plugin <plugin>/skills/<name> (as /plugin:skill), enterprise managed dir; --add-dir adds more. Edits apply mid-session; a brand-new top-level skills dir needs /reload-skills.
A skill can run a shell command before Claude sees it: !`cmd` or a ```! block, 2 minute default timeout, checked against permission rules, disabled by disableSkillShellExecution.

A plugin is a directory with .claude-plugin/plugin.json (only name required), skills/, commands/, agents/, hooks/hooks.json, .mcp.json, bin/. One plugin delivers skill plus hooks. Env passed to hooks: CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_<KEY>.

Plugin install: claude plugin marketplace add, claude plugin install name@marketplace [--scope user|project|local]; scopes write enabledPlugins to ~/.claude/settings.json, .claude/settings.json or .claude/settings.local.json; --plugin-dir loads one for a session; /reload-plugins applies changes.

sandbox_and_network.claim: Timeout cancels a hook and discards its output. Defaults: 600 s command/http/mcp_tool, 30 s prompt, 60 s agent, 30 s on UserPromptSubmit and the model-switch events, 10 s MessageDisplay.
http hooks POST the input JSON to a URL; headers may use $VAR listed in allowedEnvVars. async:true command hooks run in the background, cannot block, and are killed at teardown in -p mode.
Cloud sessions run on Anthropic's machines; a repo-committed .claude/settings.json hook runs there but cannot reach the user's disk.

other_observation_channels.claim: Session transcript JSONL at transcript_path (~/.claude/projects/<cwd-slug>/<session>.jsonl), written asynchronously and may lag the hook.
Stop and SubagentStop carry last_assistant_message so the closing text needs no transcript read.
claude --debug logs each command hook with command, plugin, outcome, duration (2.1.296+).
OpenTelemetry events: prompt_id matches the prompt.id attribute.

helpers_or_subagents.claim: meta.json keys: agentType, description, toolUseId (the launching call), spawnDepth, requestShape, requestNonInteractive, model, finished.
Hooks fired inside a subagent carry agent_id and agent_type in the common fields; SubagentStart/SubagentStop bracket it.
2.1.302 turned fork subagents on by default in claude -p, SDK, desktop and VS Code.

limits_and_timeouts.claim: Default hook timeout 600 s (command/http/mcp_tool); 30 s on UserPromptSubmit and model-switch events; 10 s MessageDisplay; prompt 30 s; agent 60 s; SessionEnd shared 1.5 s budget up to 60 s.

Exit 0 success (stdout JSON parsed); exit 2 blocking error on blocking events with stderr as reason; other exit codes non-blocking. Exit 2 does not block PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, Notification, SubagentStart, SessionStart, SessionEnd.
PreToolUse JSON hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision allow|deny|ask|defer; top-level decision block for Post*, Stop, SubagentStop, UserPromptSubmit.

A timed-out hook's output is discarded. hooks.md says PreToolUse is then not blocked unless onFailure is 'block' (2.1.295+); the Agent SDK page says a timed-out PreToolUse blocks the call with a 'hook didn't respond' result (2.1.210+).
limits_and_timeouts.note: Two official pages disagree (hooks vs agent-sdk/hooks https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/hooks). Set onFailure explicitly if it matters; a probe with a sleeping PreToolUse hook would settle it.

limits_and_timeouts.claim: Hook output strings are capped at 10,000 characters.

Native installer keeps the launcher's version plus two newest on disk; three versions 2.1.300-2.1.302 present.
